title: Luxurious comfort and power
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the G70 as luxurious, comfortable, and sometimes powerful, while many other fragments mention luxury without enough context to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise a luxurious cabin and ride comfort, sometimes adding power, dependability, sportiness, or advanced technology.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly use brief luxury-focused descriptions that lack enough context to confirm a clear evaluative sentiment assignment.

limitations: The sampled fragments are heavily centered on luxury wording, so there is limited evidence about other aspects of comfort or interior quality beyond short descriptors.
Many undetermined examples are very brief, which limits confidence about why they were not assigned a clearer sentiment.
The examples appear coherent around luxury, comfort, and power, but the sample is small and not representative of the full model population.
